app.description: Free, open-source AI subtitle translator for SRT, VTT and ASS. No sign-up.
application.accessibility: Semantic landmarks and headings, labelled navigation, a skip link, visible keyboard focus, keyboard-operable controls, light and dark themes and reduced-motion support.
application.feature.1: Scene-level translation: sentences and scenes are recognized automatically, then translated as a whole
application.feature.10: 200+ languages with no sign-up, no ads and no tracking
application.feature.11: Open source under the MIT license; subtitle content is never stored
application.feature.2: Keeps meaning accurate, terminology consistent, character relationships correct and context coherent
application.feature.3: Keeps every original timestamp and restores the translation precisely onto the original cues
application.feature.4: Glossary and background notes that steer terminology and tone
application.feature.5: Review editor that flags missing, overlong, too-fast and untranslated lines before download
application.feature.6: Bilingual or translation-only output with professional subtitle typography for 200+ languages
application.feature.7: Rich professional options: translation engine, glossary, background notes, line wrapping, bilingual stacking and ASS presets for desktop and mobile
application.feature.8: Batch translation of multiple files, folders and ZIP archives
application.feature.9: Conversion between SRT, VTT and ASS, and SDH cue removal
organization.description: A non-profit, open-source subtitle community connecting viewers, translators, developers and film professionals.
